title: Overnight Slots
description: Canonical slot type definition for skills/overnight-run/OVERNIGHT.md. Slots are normally filled inline in the markdown; this schema is the canonical type contract and the target shape if slots are serialized to JSON for tooling.

DEADLINE.description: Absolute ISO-8601 timestamp; triggers section 4.4 stop rule

TEST_CMD.description: Test command; run twice (cheap runs three times) in Phase 0, FLAKY set defined only then

LINT_CMD.description: Red-line check command; installed into the pre-commit hook in Phase 0 step 7

BENCH_CMD.description: Benchmark command; null when the repo has no performance surface (delete the bench section then)

PERF_METRICS.description: Metric names to take medians over (5 runs)

ISSUE_LIST.description: Phase 1 issue list; triage with a fixed small budget each before fixing

SPEC_FILE.description: Phase 2 spec source; the single source of truth for shape

ALLOWED_COMPONENTS.description: Whitelist of allowed components; anything else is wrong even if inlined or moved

BANNED_PATTERNS.description: Syntax red lines; enforced by the pre-commit hook with no exceptions

QUARANTINE_BUDGET.description: Max quarantined tests; 0 is the expectation, not the quota

MAX_PASSES.description: Consecutive non-converging passes before Phase 2 ends as over-budget

ESCAPE_HATCHES.description: Language escape-hatch syntax; leave empty/null when none exist

SCOPE_PREFIX.description: Commit message prefix for this run
